purpose: Test the width-64 variable-axis Mamba on PEMS07 H12 after correcting selected-lag relation supervision.
research_question: Can a prediction-connected AutoCon variable-token Mamba be non-inferior to the frozen PEMS07 TimeMixer validation reference while retaining its measured forward-latency advantage?
selection_history: The width was selected only from Solar/Traffic validation architecture screens and a pre-training PEMS07 GPU resource probe. No PEMS07 validation metric from the new seeds was used in selection.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory screen. No test metric is generated, inspected, or used for selection.
claim_boundary: A favorable result permits only a separately frozen multi-dataset confirmation; it cannot establish a publication claim or an independent AutoCon effect.
prelaunch_gates: verify PEMS07 fingerprint and multivariate geometry
freeze width-64 active/null graphs and fresh paired seeds
verify the pre-training fusion-enabled GPU forward measurement
require selected-lag masking so relation positives retain denominator negatives

phases.name: pems07_h12_variable_mamba_d64_relation_null
phases.purpose: Prediction-connected graph with the requested relation objective constructed but lambda zero.

phases.name: pems07_h12_variable_mamba_d64_relation_active
phases.purpose: Exact paired graph with the train-only selected-lag AutoCon relation objective active.

primary_contrasts: each arm versus the frozen PEMS07 TimeMixer validation mean
comparison_contract.resource_contract: The active prediction path was measured at B32/L96/C883/H12 on RTX 5090 D before training.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: No test-set, all-PEMS, long-horizon, or general time-series claim is permitted.

stopping_rules: Do not change architecture, seeds, or training budget after launch.
If both arms are more than 1% worse than the frozen TimeMixer PEMS07 reference, stop this route before multi-dataset expansion.
If relation telemetry has zero contrastive active anchors or all positives are degenerate, treat the active arm as invalid and do not make an AutoCon claim.
